transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to discuss scheduling the controlled ES-25 trial on Furnace 1 before Friday, as required by the corporate energy program. Before I can approve the trial schedule and operating controls, I need to check with quality, maintenance, utilities, and process safety per our normal change-control routine. Could we go through those sign-offs now so we can get the trial moving?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, from the quality side I can share what I found this morning. I reviewed the customer qualification file, and an ES-25 trial requires exactly 3 witness coupons and a hardness test before any trial parts can be released. I completed this review but haven't yet attached it to the change-control record, so let me make sure that gets done so it's properly documented.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning Mara. Before we schedule the ES-25 trial on Furnace 1, I need to flag a maintenance issue. During my inspection I found that thermocouple T3 on Furnace 1 is reading 5 degrees Celsius low. The approved correction is a recalibration that takes exactly 2 hours. I've reserved the calibration equipment for 20:00 tonight, but the recalibration hasn't been completed yet and I haven't updated the maintenance board. We should factor this into the trial scheduling — running the ES-25 trial with an inaccurate thermocouple could compromise the results, so the recalibration needs to be completed first.
